|61|NR|RW|Non-Readable bit (NR) of the page table entry.|

|63|RPLV|RW|Restricted Privilege LeVel enable (RPLV) of the page table. When RPLV=0, the page table entry can be accessed by any program whose privilege level is not lower than PLV; when RPLV=1, the page table entry can only be accessed by programs whose privilege level is equal to PLV.|
grades.reason: Directly explains PLV/RPLV access restrictions and identifies NR/NX as non-readable/non-executable restrictions.
